title: Purgatory, hell and the last things
tagline: Purgatory and indulgences, hell, heaven, judgment and the question of universalism.
whyItMatters: Death is the question every person faces. The Church’s teaching on judgment, purification and hope gives hard truths and real comfort.

mindset.tip: Meet fear and grief with gentleness before doctrine; many ask about death because someone has died.
Keep purgatory and indulgences apart; a friend can accept one and doubt the other.
Say plainly that hell is real, God wants all saved and the Church names no one as damned. (CCC 1033-1037)
Listen to Protestant concerns about the sufficiency of Christ’s sacrifice.
